notes.title: 📢❗🚨 Kebabstar Prologue is NOW LIVE!
notes.content:
[h1]The Kebabstar Prologue is [b]Available NOW[/b]![/h1][p][/p][h1]      [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45677598/ef01fe940016c70c05606110e0a472e08afda138.png"][/img][/h1][p]
Hey, stars! 🌟[/p][p]The moment we've all been waiting for is here! We are thrilled to announce that the [b]free Kebabstar Prologue [/b]is [b]now available[/b] for everyone to play! [/p][p][/p][h2]What's in the [b]Prologue[/b]?[/h2][p][/p][p]In this [b]introductory[/b] chapter, you will get a [b]taste[/b] of the [b]core mechanics[/b] of the [i]Kebabstar [b]universe[/b][/i]:[/p][list][*][p][b]🌯Art of the Kebab: [/b]Involved with your real hands to make delicious kebabs ever you never made it before![/p][/*][*][p]😎 [b]Glasses:[/b] You are AI Agent but you don't know what it is supposed to be? What is the behind of the exile from desert?[/p][/*][*][p][b]💼 Truth of the Businessman:[/b] Find the Atilla's letter in Grand Bazaar's luxury jewelry shop to find the information about the Bearded One.[/p][/*][/list][p]This is just the beginning! By playing the prologue, you can provide us with valuable feedback and get a head start as an experienced AI Agent when the full game launches.
[/p][p]Download and [b]play for free[/b] right now![/p][p][/p][p]And don't forget to add the full game to your [b]wishlist[/b] and [b]follow[/b] us our main game to keep updated![/p][p]Happy cooking![/p][p][/p]

notes.title: 3️⃣ Days Until Kebabstar: Prologue 🎮🔥
notes.content: [h1]3 Days Until Kebabstar: Prologue 🎮🔥[/h1][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45677598/a836f57d47f2cad1fb187a141771906130c7c7c0.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]In just 3 days, Kebabstar: Prologue will let players step into this unique adventure blending cooking simulation with humor, creativity, and unexpected twists.[/p][p][/p][p]Boran is not your usual chef.[/p][p][/p][p]Glasses on.[/p][p][/p][p]His camel is missing...[/p][p][/p][p]A cult is waiting in Cyprus.[/p][p][/p][p]And his only weapon… is his mastery of kebab.[/p][p][/p][p]Prologue is coming.[/p]

notes.title: KEBABSTAR PROLOGUE: RELEASE DATE 🔜 1️⃣5️⃣ AUGUST
notes.content:
[h2]🎉 [b]KEBABSTAR PROLOGUE COMING IN 15 AUGUST[/b][/h2][h2]Get ready for a free culinary adventure! 

KEBABSTAR PROLOGUE is launching on [b]August 15th![/b]  

Embark on an exciting journey through the first three chapters, each bursting with unique flavors and vibrant settings. First, spice things up in [b]Arabian Deserts[/b], where luxury party meets with the Boran's destiny. Then, experience the modern [b]Beach Of Dubai[/b]. Finally, immerse yourself in the rich history and bustling energy of [b]Istanbul's Grand Bazaar[/b], a crossroads of cultures and tastes. 

[b]Mark your calendars! 🗓️[/b] 

This mouthwatering prologue is just the beginning!🎮
[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45677598/cdf966587a054d4179d8c74ad2822ae589a796fe.png"][/img][/p][h2][/h2]
